definition: Having or showing a habitually forgetful or inattentive disposition
examples: The absent-minded professor forgot where he had parked his car.

definition: To suffer from a continuous dull pain
examples: My legs ache after running ten kilometers yesterday.

definition: A continuous or prolonged dull pain in a part of one's body
examples: He woke up with a dull ache in his lower back.

definition: Causing or likely to cause someone to become physically or mentally dependent on a substance or activity
examples: Coffee and energy drinks contain caffeine, which is mildly addictive.

definition: A substance added to something in small quantities to improve or preserve it
examples: This natural fruit juice contains no artificial additives or preservatives.

definition: A hormone secreted by the adrenal glands that increases rates of blood circulation and breathing under stress
examples: Skydiving gives you an incredible rush of adrenalin.

definition: A medicine that prevents or corrects acidity, especially in the stomach
examples: He took an antacid tablet to relieve his indigestion after dinner.

definition: Medicines that inhibit the growth of or destroy microorganisms and bacterial infections
examples: The doctor prescribed a seven-day course of antibiotics for her infection.

definition: A drug that inhibits the physiological effects of histamine, used especially in the treatment of allergies
examples: She takes an antihistamine every morning during the spring pollen season.

definition: Drugs or substances used to reduce inflammation, swelling, and pain
examples: The athlete took anti-inflammatories to reduce the swelling in his knee.

definition: A topical ointment applied to cuts or scrapes to prevent infection
examples: Clean the cut with water and apply some antiseptic cream before putting on a plaster.

definition: To go to and participate in an organized group exercise session
examples: She likes to attend a fitness class three times a week to stay active.

definition: A strip of material used to bind a wound or to protect an injured part of the body
examples: The nurse wrapped a tight bandage around his sprained wrist.

definition: Low in price, or of low quality
examples: Fresh vegetables are very cheap at the local market in summer.

definition: An infection that affects the lungs or the large airways, such as bronchitis or pneumonia
examples: He has been coughing all week because of a nasty chest infection.

definition: A waxy, fat-like substance found in the blood and body cells that can cause heart disease in high amounts
examples: Eating too much fried food can raise your blood cholesterol levels.

definition: Blocked with mucus so as to make breathing difficult
examples: My nose is completely congested because of this bad cold.

definition: Fitting in well with a person's needs, activities, and plans
examples: The gym is in a very convenient location right next to my office.

definition: To cause to change in form, character, or function
examples: During digestion, the body works to convert food into usable energy.

definition: An act or sound of expelling air from the lungs with a sudden sharp sound
examples: He has had a persistent dry cough for over a week.

definition: A liquid medication taken to soothe a sore throat and suppress coughing
examples: Take a spoonful of cough medicine before going to sleep.

definition: A wound or opening made in skin by a sharp edge or tool
examples: He got a small cut on his finger while chopping onions.

definition: Food produced from the milk of mammals, such as cheese, butter, and yogurt
examples: Dairy products like milk and cheese are rich in calcium.

definition: Containing a large number of people living in a relatively small area
examples: Tokyo is one of the most densely populated cities in the world.

definition: Having a sensation of spinning around and losing one's balance
examples: Standing up too quickly made him feel dizzy for a moment.

definition: To perform vigorous exercises designed to strengthen the heart and lungs
examples: They meet at the sports center every Tuesday to do aerobics.

definition: The strength and vitality required for sustained physical or mental activity
examples: Eating a healthy breakfast gives you plenty of energy for the day.

definition: To have a strong desire to win or be more successful than others
examples: You have to be competitive if you want to succeed in professional sports.

definition: To defeat someone you are playing or fighting against in a game or contest
examples: She trained for months to finally beat an opponent who had never lost before.

definition: An injury appearing as an area of discolored skin on the body, caused by a blow or impact
examples: He had a dark purple bruise on his leg after falling off his bike.

definition: To use up energy, fat, or calories through physical activity
examples: Swimming is an excellent way to burn calories and tone your muscles.

definition: A sudden, brief, and intense effort or display of energy or speed
examples: The sprinter won the race with a final burst of speed near the finish line.

definition: A chemical element and mineral essential for building and maintaining strong bones and teeth
examples: Milk, yogurt, and leafy greens are great sources of calcium.

definition: Units of energy supplied by food and released when the body breaks it down
examples: He checks the food labels to keep track of how many calories he consumes.

definition: A substance found in foods like bread, pasta, and potatoes that provides the body with heat and energy
examples: Runners often eat meals high in carbohydrates before a marathon.

definition: Able to speak the English language, or having English as a primary or official language
examples: They hired an English-speaking tour guide for their trip.

definition: Costing a lot of money
examples: Organic food is sometimes more expensive than regular supermarket items.

definition: Having wide, significant, and long-lasting effects or consequences
examples: Poor nutrition in childhood can have far-reaching consequences for adult health.

definition: A natural oily substance occurring in animal bodies, or a nutrient in food that supplies energy
examples: Avocados and nuts contain healthy fats that are good for your heart.

definition: Feeling extremely tired and drained of energy
examples: Lack of iron in your diet can make you feel fatigued all the time.

definition: Dietary material containing substances such as cellulose that help the digestive system work properly
examples: Eating wholegrain bread and fresh fruit adds plenty of fibre to your diet.

definition: A non-alcoholic beverage that contains carbon dioxide bubbles
examples: Dentists advise children to drink water instead of sugary fizzy drinks.

definition: A contagious viral infection that causes fever, severe aching, and respiratory congestion
examples: Half the class stayed home this week because they caught the flu.

definition: The cracking or breaking of a hard object, especially a bone
examples: The X-ray showed a small fracture in his collarbone.

definition: The right or ability to choose freely without restriction
examples: Students are given a free choice of which sport they want to play.

definition: Recently made or obtained; not canned, frozen, or preserved
examples: We always buy fresh fish and vegetables at the weekend market.

definition: To run outdoors or on a track as a form of physical exercise
examples: I like to go running in the park every morning before work.

definition: A form of indigestion felt as a burning sensation in the chest, caused by acid regurgitation into the esophagus
examples: Eating spicy food late at night often gives him terrible heartburn.

definition: Containing a large number of calories and providing a lot of energy
examples: You should avoid high-calorie snacks like chocolate and crisps if you want to lose weight.

definition: Any of the foods or substances that are combined to make a particular dish
examples: Garlic is a key ingredient in many Mediterranean dishes.

definition: A small painful wound caused when an insect such as a bee or wasp pierces the skin
examples: Apply some antihistamine cream to the insect sting to stop the itching.

definition: The measurable amount of a property, such as force, brightness, or physical effort
examples: You should gradually increase the intensity of your workouts over time.

definition: To do physical exercises regularly in order to stay healthy and strong
examples: Cycling to work every day is a great way to keep fit.

definition: To work the pedals of a stationary bicycle for physical fitness
examples: He likes to watch the news while he pedals on an exercise bike at the gym.

definition: To participate in an athletic game that involves players working together as a group
examples: Children learn cooperation when they play a team sport like basketball or football.

definition: Domestic fowl, such as chickens, turkeys, ducks, and geese, raised for meat or eggs
examples: Lean poultry like chicken breast is a great source of low-fat protein.

definition: A substance used to preserve foodstuffs against decay and spoilage
examples: Salt has been used as a natural food preservative for centuries.

definition: Having been treated or prepared by a special method, especially in order to preserve it
examples: Processed cheese lasts much longer than fresh farm cheese.

definition: Food that has been altered from its natural state for safety, convenience, or shelf life, often containing added salt, sugar, and fat
examples: Nutritionists recommend cutting down on processed food and eating more fresh meals.

definition: An essential nutrient found in meat, eggs, beans, and milk that helps build and repair body tissues and muscle
examples: Athletes need plenty of protein in their diet to help their muscles recover.

definition: The edible seeds of various leguminous plants, such as chickpeas, lentils, and beans
examples: Pulses like lentils and beans are excellent sources of plant-based protein.

definition: To force liquid or gas to move in a specified direction, or to exercise with weights
examples: Brisk walking makes your heart pump blood faster around your body.

definition: To try as hard as physically or mentally possible
examples: During the marathon, I had to push myself to the limit to reach the finish line.

definition: Reducing the amount of time needed to do something
examples: Pre-chopped vegetables are a convenient, time-saving option for busy evenings.

definition: Something well worth the money spent on it
examples: The annual gym membership offers great value for money if you go regularly.

definition: A microscopic infective agent that multiplies within the living cells of a host and causes disease
examples: Antibiotics do not work against illnesses caused by a virus, such as the common cold.

definition: Organic compounds essential in small quantities for normal nutrition, growth, and health
examples: Citrus fruits are packed with essential vitamins that support your immune system.

definition: Highly regarded or admired by many people
examples: She is a well-respected surgeon at the national hospital.

definition: Composed in a clear, engaging, and skilful style
examples: This health guide is very well-written and easy for beginners to understand.

definition: Grain or food made from grain that contains all the natural essential parts and nutrients of the entire seed
examples: Switching from white bread to wholegrain is a simple way to eat healthier.

definition: Control exerted to do something or restrain impulses
examples: It takes a lot of will power to give up eating sweets completely.

definition: An injury to living tissue caused by a cut, blow, or other impact, typically one in which the skin is cut or broken
examples: The doctor cleaned the deep wound and stitched it up carefully.

definition: A photographic or digital image of the internal composition of something, especially a part of the body
examples: He went to the hospital to get an X-ray of his injured ankle.

definition: To lift heavy equipment such as dumbbells or barbells as a form of exercise to strengthen muscles
examples: He goes to the gym four times a week to lift weights and build muscle.

definition: Amusing and entertaining; cheerful and carefree
examples: We had a light-hearted chat over coffee after our workout.

definition: A large amount of fluids, such as water, tea, or juice, consumed to keep the body hydrated
examples: When you have a fever, the doctor will advise you to drink lots of liquids.

definition: Containing fewer calories than standard food items
examples: Cucumber and celery are great low-calorie snacks.

definition: An inorganic substance needed by the human body in small amounts for good health, such as iron or calcium
examples: Spinach is rich in iron, an essential mineral for healthy blood.

definition: Smelling, looking, or sounding delicious
examples: The bakery window was filled with mouth-watering pastries and cakes.

definition: Greatly required or necessary
examples: After working nonstop for months, she took a much-needed vacation.

definition: Affected with nausea; feeling inclined to vomit
examples: The rough boat ride across the channel made several passengers feel nauseous.

definition: An instance of bleeding from the nose
examples: Dry winter air sometimes gives him a sudden nose bleed.

definition: A substance that provides nourishment essential for growth and the maintenance of life
examples: Fresh fruits and vegetables provide the body with vital nutrients.

definition: In or according to styles or types no longer current or common; not modern
examples: My grandmother still uses old-fashioned home remedies for a cold.

definition: Drugs or medicines used for relieving pain
examples: She took two painkillers to get rid of her severe headache.

definition: An area of redness and spots on a person's skin, appearing especially as a result of allergy or illness
examples: Eating strawberries gave him an itchy red rash on his arms.

definition: Surpassing a previous best performance or record
examples: The athlete finished the race in a record-breaking time.

definition: A period of relaxing, sleeping, or doing nothing after a period of activity
examples: The doctor told him to stay in bed and get plenty of rest.

definition: A white crystalline substance (sodium chloride) used for seasoning or preserving food
examples: Adding too much salt to your food can increase your blood pressure.

definition: A type of fat found chiefly in animal products such as butter, cheese, and meat, which can raise cholesterol levels
examples: Butter and fatty meats contain high levels of saturated fat.

definition: A condition marked by pain or irritation in the throat, typically caused by a cold or virus
examples: Drinking warm tea with honey helps soothe a sore throat.

definition: An injury to a joint caused by a sudden wrenching and stretching of its ligaments
examples: It wasn't a broken bone, just a bad ankle sprain.

definition: Unable to move easily and without pain, especially in the muscles or joints
examples: My neck and shoulders feel stiff after sitting at the computer all day.

definition: A sweet crystalline substance obtained from various plants, especially sugar cane and sugar beet
examples: She prefers to drink her green tea without any sugar.

definition: Larger or rounder than normal, typically as a result of injury or inflammation
examples: His knee was badly swollen after he fell during the football match.

definition: Small solid disks or masses of medicine taken orally
examples: Take two of these tablets with a glass of water after meals.

definition: Having a pleasant, distinct flavor
examples: She made a very tasty vegetable soup for lunch.

definition: The degree of internal heat of a person's body, or a body temperature above the normal level (a fever)
examples: The child felt hot to the touch and had a high temperature.

definition: Small medicated candies dissolved slowly in the mouth to soothe an irritated throat
examples: I bought a packet of throat sweets at the pharmacy to stop my coughing.
